semantics: This v2 run reroutes all 191 Editions belonging to the six predecessor project works whose component registry changed after human audit.

The frozen project-level human resolution_plan and resolution_note predate registry v2 and are historical context. Where they omit or conflict with a registry-v2 component, the fixed registry v2 is authoritative.
No previous row-level LLM routing answer or human audit decision is supplied to the model.
One LLM call is made per predecessor project work, with all of that Work's Edition records visible together.
The LLM may assign an Edition only to a human-defined fixed component for the same predecessor project work, or return HOLD_UNRESOLVED.
The LLM may not create, merge, or split component boundaries.
An omnibus or anthology is routed as one Edition-level publication and is not decomposed into constituent literary works.
DETACH, EXCLUDE_APPARATUS, and PRIMARY_SUCCESSOR_HINT are human component metadata, not LLM routing decisions.
This release does not create source entities, project works, lineage edges, or corpus-scope decisions.
